subject: Renewal demo consolidation & procurement timeline
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Martinez <alicia@greenriverhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 2 Sep 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal demo consolidation & procurement timeline

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. As we prep for your renewal/expansion QBR, wanted to propose a consolidated approach to the demo and procurement kickoff so we minimize meeting fatigue for your execs and get procurement the materials they need to start the SOW and security review.

High level proposal:
- One 90-minute session for the exec roadmap + product demo (customer-facing stakeholders)
- Followed immediately by a 30–45 minute procurement sync with your procurement team and our finance/legal lead to walk the SOW, payment terms, and the security questionnaire

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue, Sep 12 — 10:00–11:30 (demo) + 11:30–12:15 (procurement)
- Wed, Sep 13 — 14:00–15:30 (demo) + 15:30–16:15 (procurement)
- Thu, Sep 14 — 09:00–10:30 (demo) + 10:30–11:15 (procurement)

Attached: GreenRiver-MAP-v2.pdf (updated agenda/attendees) and a draft SOW (SOW_draft_GreenRiver.docx) for procurement to preview. Can you confirm which window you prefer and whether procurement wants a standalone doc review instead of the immediate handoff?

If helpful, we can compress the demo to 60 minutes and extend the procurement sync; I put Karthik and Monica on Cc to help run the technical and commercial sections.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: GreenRiver-MAP-v2.pdf (agenda), SOW_draft_GreenRiver.docx (draft SOW)

From: Alicia Martinez <alicia@greenriverhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@greenriverhealth.com>, Sam Turner <sturner@greenriverhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Sep 2028 11:17:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal demo consolidation & procurement timeline

Irene —

Thanks for pulling this together and for the clear options. Procurement will need a short window to review the SOW and the security questionnaire before they join the same meeting as the execs. Their request is:

- Can you provide the vendor security questionnaire (we attached the one procurement uses) and a short answers matrix for the SOC2 / data retention / encryption items?
- We prefer the procurement sync to be a separate 45-minute meeting the same week, not immediately after the exec demo. That helps our procurement lead prep and not be rushed between execs.

From my side, right now Sep 12 is tight for our exec sponsor. Best windows for us are: Sep 13 morning ET (9:00–11:00 ET) or Sep 14 morning ET (9:00–11:00 ET). Sep 13 afternoon ET is not ideal because of a leadership offsite.

I’m looping procurement in this thread — procurement@greenriverhealth.com will confirm their availability and next steps. I’ve attached the vendor questionnaire they asked us to send to vendors.

Thanks — Alicia
Head of Platform Strategy
GreenRiver Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Martinez <alicia@greenriverhealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@greenriverhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Sep 2028 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal demo consolidation & procurement timeline

Hi Alicia — thanks for the quick reply and for attaching the questionnaire. I grabbed that file and took a first pass — we can return a short answers matrix that maps to the procurement rows by EOD Monday.

Operationally, we can split the engagements as you asked: 60–75 minute exec demo + a separate 45-minute procurement review later the same week. Proposed finalized slots (I converted to ET below for clarity):
- Tue, Sep 13 — 09:00–10:15 ET (demo, 75 min)
- Thu, Sep 14 — 09:00–09:45 ET (procurement review, 45 min)

Run-of-show (demo):
1) 10 min — Exec context & renewal ask (Irene)
2) 30 min — Product roadmap + targeted use cases (Karthik)
3) 20 min — Live demo + performance notes (Monica)
4) 15 min — Q&A & next steps (Irene + customer)
Action items from our side:
- We’ll fill the vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx with short answers and a supporting note for any items that require follow-up (deliverable: matrix.pdf)
- I’ll upload a DocuSign link for the revised SOW to speed procurement review (expectation: pre-signed SOW review copy)
Can procurement confirm Sep 14 09:00–09:45 ET? If that works we’ll pencil Sep 13 09:00–10:15 ET for the demo and send calendar invites.
—Karthik
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 5 Sep 2028 09:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal demo consolidation & procurement timeline

Thanks — confirmed.

We’ll take the Tue, Sep 13 09:00–10:15 ET slot for the demo (75 minutes). Procurement confirms Thu, Sep 14 09:00–09:45 ET for the contract review. Procurement will join the demo only for the first 10 minutes for context, then rejoin on Thu for the full review.

Next steps for Redwood team:
- Complete the vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx and share the answers matrix by EOD Monday (Sep 11).
- Send calendar invites for both meetings with clear attendee lists and the run-of-show (Irene/Karthik).
- Upload a DocuSign preview for the SOW so procurement can queue legal review ahead of the Thu sync.
Irene — Sam (our renewal sponsor) will be on both invites; procurement@greenriverhealth.com is looped. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Alicia Martinez
Head of Platform Strategy
GreenRiver Health
